featured_reviews.name: Arvind Padwad
featured_reviews.review_text:
Think Multiple Times Before Booking Rajasthan Tour with Kesari (Especially Foreign Tourist Circuits)

There is a big difference between what is written in the itinerary, what you understand, and what is actually shown. And if you complain about this mismatch, you are indirectly made to admit before their grievance officer that you “do not understand English.” Very disappointing approach.

Day 1 & 2 – Lemon Tree Hotel

Hotel, cleanliness, and staff: 10/10
Excellent stay and service.

Guide: 6/10
Shared too much unnecessary information (statues, random shops, medical stores, etc.) instead of relevant insights.

Day 3 & 4 – Hotel Chirag

Hotel & food: 4/10
Very poor room condition and food quality.

Guide: 10/10
Extremely knowledgeable, organized, and informative.

Day 5 – Travel & Lunch at Pokhran

Lunch arrangement was disappointing.
Other tour companies were given an AC hall, while Kesari guests were served in general space with very ordinary food.
Rating: 3/10

Desert Stay – Om Tent (Worst Experience)

This was one of the worst nights of my life.

A nail under the carpet pierced my foot.

Electric socket was burning.

Complaints to tent owner were ignored.

Food was cold and tasteless.

Rating: –10/10

Camel Safari

Owner was only focused on extracting more money.
After just 50 meters of ride, he demanded extra payment for a 1 km desert ride.
No proper concern for safety.
Ride completely at your own risk.

Rating: 4/10

Jaisalmer – Hotel Orchid

Extremely disrespectful behavior.

Four senior citizens were forcefully made to leave their dining table without any reservation conflict.

No manager or senior staff available.

Staff appeared more interested in getting tips from foreign tourists.

Rooms for foreign guests seemed well maintained; others were not.

Rating: 0/10

Tour Manager

On the 8th day, the tour manager suddenly realized that 75% of tourists were senior citizens and required care. That awareness should have been there from Day 1.

Later Part of Tour

From Day 10 onward, travel arrangements improved.
We were finally given a comfortable bus.

Hotel Vega (Jodhpur) – Good
Howard Johnson (Udaipur) – Good

Additional Concerns

Guides and tour manager consistently promoted “authenticated” shops where prices were 3–5 times higher than normal market rates.

Most hotels were booked far from tourist spots, markets, and airports.

Clear difference in treatment between foreign tourists and others.

Final Suggestion

If you truly want to explore Rajasthan, visit independently without a tour agency.
Local people are polite and helpful. Food is good. You can explore peacefully without overpricing or pressure tactics.

Overall, this trip wasn’t just a vacation—it was a collection of lifetime memories. Watching our kids enjoy the beaches, spending quality time as a family, and experiencing the beauty of Andaman together is something we will cherish forever.

A big thank you to Travel Happiness for making this journey so special, comfortable, and truly memorable. Highly recommended for anyone planning a family trip—you can trust them to deliver an experience you’ll never forget!
